snippet.title: Salvation Denied - Demo Trailer
snippet.description:
DEMO OUT NOW: https://store.steampowered.com/app/4193590/Salvation_Denied

Salvation Denied is built around a series of distinct missions, each with its own challenge, physics-driven construction system, and set of environmental disasters waiting to ruin your best-laid plans. The demo launches today with Mission 1, ‘Signal to Orbit’, where you build a base of any shape, get the antenna to hit the signal, and try not to get flattened by meteor showers. 

Wishlist the game on Steam!
http://s.team/a/4193590

Join on Discord → https://discord.gg/salvdeniedgame
